limits: Native functional acceptance of the named scripts at the tested source revision; not completion of the feature or the full release matrix.
macOS 27.0.1 arm64; Linux Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 in the isolated Colima container, with Xvfb and a host-mounted workspace.
Supervisor timings are one combined Rust/XAML edit per platform. Watch polling/debounce is excluded; compiler time is included; compositor completion is not physical display scan-out.
Validation jobs may overlap; these are functional observations, not isolated benchmarks or percentile estimates.
The standalone probe deliberately panics during one candidate transaction and verifies rollback; its successful exit is required.
Windows execution, the current Linux standalone probe, and the remaining integration and release gates are not established by this artifact.
